business_problem: With Pfizer teams highly focused on ongoing technology projects, PACT addresses challenges around the bandwidth needed for prototyping. “With this collaboration, AWS brings in its prototyping teams to work with business and IT teams directly on relevant challenges,” says Bulusu.
solution_summary: Learn how Pfizer and AWS are collaborating to build generative AI prototypes to help bring innovative therapeutics to market quickly. With a mission to transform healthcare for its 1.3 billion patients, Pfizer is always seeking to innovate using cutting-edge technology. To optimize the development of new medicines through cloud-based solutions, Pfizer and Amazon Web Services (AWS) have created the Pfizer-Amazon Collaboration Team (PACT) initiative. Under PACT, Pfizer has pursued 14 projects, including generative artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) to save scientists up to 16,000 hours of search time annually and cut infrastructure costs by 55 percent. Pfizer uses a plethora of tools from AWS to explore new ideas, quickly build prototypes, and drive a passion for innovation in digital drug development. Source data enters the Pfizer workflow through its application services, processed with Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Bedrock, and delivered through Amazon Kendra.

solution_components.name: Amazon SageMaker
solution_components.role: Supports model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, or managed inference for the customer workload.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Hosts the foundation models and inference APIs that power the generative AI features.

solution_components.name: Amazon Kendra
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and powers semantic retrieval over internal knowledge.
